observation.command:
cd /tmp/dist
# MapServer config -> /opt/mapserver
python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('conf/xplan-mapserver-config.zip').extractall('/opt/mapserver')"
echo "=== mapserver config ==="; ls /opt/mapserver
# XPlanCLI -> /opt/xplanbox/cli
mkdir -p /opt/xplanbox/cli && python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('bin/xplan-cli.zip').extractall('/opt/xplanbox/cli')"
echo "=== cli ==="; ls /opt/xplanbox/cli; ls /opt/xplanbox/cli/bin 2>/dev/null
# validator executor -> /opt/xplanbox/
cp bin/xplan-validator-executor.jar /opt/xplanbox/xplan-validator-executor.jar
ls -la /opt/xplanbox/*.jar
